data.name: Rebase_Archives_Tooltip
data.value: Some emulators do not read archives (on ArkOS: PSP, GameCube, Saturn, Dreamcast). The target architecture says which systems require extraction. Arcade romsets are never extracted.

data.name: Rebase_ExtractLayout_Tooltip
data.value: A single extracted file takes the game name directly in the system folder. Several files (bin + cue) keep their internal names in a folder named after the game.

data.name: Rebase_CopyCovers_Tooltip
data.value: Copies each cover into the images folder of the system, named after the ROM (EmulationStation local art).

data.name: Rebase_GenerateGamelist_Tooltip
data.value: Writes title, description, year, developer, publisher, genres and players for each copied game, in the file the target reads. An existing file is merged: favorites, play counts and hidden games on the device are preserved.

data.name: Settings_Architectures_Description
data.value: All architectures live in your user data folder: the defaults are copied there on first launch and can be adjusted, duplicated, completed or removed. The original default files can be restored at any time.

data.name: ArchEditor_Delete_Shipped_Message
data.value: This default architecture will be removed from your architectures folder. "Restore default architectures" copies the original files back.

data.name: ArchEditor_Delete_Last
data.value: At least one architecture must remain.

data.name: ArchEditor_RestoreShipped_Message
data.value: The original files of every default architecture are copied back into your architectures folder: deleted ones return, modified ones are overwritten. Your own architectures are kept.

data.name: Rebase_Rules_Hint
data.value: Per-system rules — romsets, M3U, extraction — are defined by the target architecture.

data.name: Rebase_Column_Romset_Tooltip
data.value: Keep the original archive name (arcade romsets): never extracted, never grouped in an M3U

data.name: Rebase_Column_M3U_Tooltip
data.value: The emulator reads M3U playlists: multi-disc games get one playlist

data.name: Rebase_Column_Extract_Tooltip
data.value: The emulator does not read archives: extract them. Only applies in the mode "Extract as the architecture requires"

data.name: Rebase_Rule_Tooltip
data.value: Value from the target architecture for this system. Toggle it to override it for this game only, for this rebase.

data.value: Uncheck every game, hidden ones included

data.value: No target architecture defined: rebase is impossible.

data.name: Rebase_NoArchitecture_Message
data.value: No target architecture is available. Open "Manage architectures…" to restore the default ones or create your own.

data.name: Rebase_MetadataHint_EsDe
data.value: Metadata and covers go to an ES-DE folder at the destination root. Merge it with the ES-DE folder of the device, or import it from Cocoon.

data.name: ArchEditor_GamelistHint_None
data.value: No metadata file is written: the target reads none, or builds its list from the files alone.

data.name: ArchEditor_GamelistHint_EmulationStation
data.value: gamelist.xml in each system folder, merged with the existing one. For EmulationStation, RetroPie, ArkOS, dArkOS, Batocera, Knulli and ROCKNIX.

data.name: ArchEditor_GamelistHint_EsDe
data.value: ES-DE/gamelists/<system>/gamelist.xml at the destination root, without image tag: ES-DE ignores a gamelist placed among the ROMs and finds covers by name. Set the cover folder to ES-DE/downloaded_media/{system}/covers. Also what Cocoon imports.

data.name: ArchEditor_GamelistHint_Miyoo
data.value: miyoogamelist.xml in each system folder, limited to path, name and image. Games stored in a subfolder are left out, Onion cannot list them. Covers: Imgs folder, 250 × 360 at most.

data.name: ArchEditor_GamelistHint_Pegasus
data.value: metadata.pegasus.txt in each system folder, merged with the existing one. The launch command stays in your own Pegasus collection.

data.name: ArchEditor_GamelistHint_Logiqx
data.value: <system>.dat in each system folder, Logiqx format as written by Skraper. Read by Daijisho and ROM managers. Carries no cover.
